description: This file defines the 'Blanks' class, a specialized wizard for creating and managing conditional formatting rules related to blank and non-blank cell conditions within the PhpSpreadsheet library. It includes methods for constructing conditional format rules, interpreting existing conditions, and applying operations to set up conditional formatting for cell ranges.

classes.name: Blanks
classes.description: A wizard class to create conditional formatting rules that check whether cells are blank or not. It supports toggling inverse logic, generating appropriate formulas, and converting from existing conditional formats.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the wizard with a cell range and optional inverse flag.

methods.name: inverse
methods.description: Sets whether the condition should be inverted.

methods.name: getExpression
methods.description: Generates the formula expression based on the current configuration.

methods.name: getConditional
methods.description: Produces a Conditional object based on the wizard's current state, ready to be applied to cells.

methods.name: fromConditional
methods.description: Creates a wizard instance from an existing Conditional object, interpreting its type and conditions.

methods.name: __call
methods.description: Handles dynamic method calls to set specific operator configurations (like notBlank, isEmpty, etc.).
